# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting ChatAndCode or its hosted services (chatcode.ca,
app.chatcode.ca, and relay.chatcode.ca) by email to
[chatandcode@gmail.com](mailto:chatandcode@gmail.com). Never report them in Issues or Discord.
Please do not disclose them publicly until we have had a reasonable opportunity to investigate
and remediate them.

See the [full security policy](https://chatcode.ca/security-policy) for reporting details, scope,
and safe harbor terms for good-faith research.
